title: Level A1 Intensive French
description: Development of beginner language skills and intercultural competencies, through oral and written practice, to build the building blocks for communication and interaction, focusing on basic vocabulary, pronunciation, and simple grammar structures (familiar everyday expressions, personal details). Exploration of differences and cultural diversities in French-speaking regions and countries. Advances to an A1 level of the European Common Framework for Languages. Prepares for upper-beginner (A2) study upon completion.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of FRAN 100, FREN 100, FREN 102, FREN 103, FREN 105.
Not open to students with French 11 or equivalent in the last two years.
Not open to students with French 12.
Not open to students with French immersion at any time.
